summary.tldr: Lowers the federal voting age from 18 to 16 and updates related rules in the Canada Elections Act.
what_it_does: Changes the Canada Elections Act so Canadian citizens who are 16 or older are qualified as electors on polling day.
Changes the definition of "future elector" to mean a Canadian citizen who is 14 or 15 years old.
Repeals subsection 22(5) of the Canada Elections Act.
Updates related voting rules in sections 281.3 and 549.1 to use 16 as the age threshold.
summary.background: The bill amends the Canada Elections Act.
